capabilities.description: Builds Interim Payment Certificates from BOQ measured quantities and rates, applying the contract's retention and payment terms; the BOQ (harbourline_boq.xlsx Preliminaries and Earthworks items P1-P5, E1-E5) is the rate and quantity source of record.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over.

capabilities.description: Tracks elapsed time against Clause 8.2 time for completion (730 days) and computes delay damages at Clause 8.7 (0.1% of Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10%), exposing the running exposure to the commercial team.
requirements: Clause 8.2 Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date.
Clause 8.7 Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.
Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Captures inspection and test plan (ITP) records against construction activities and gates them on approval before the related work is claimed in an interim payment certificate.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Maintains the project document register: registers each contract, BOQ, drawing, and certificate version with provenance so that any claim or delay figure can be traced back to the exact source document revision.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Administers the contract's commercial terms beyond retention and delay damages — performance security at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount and defects notification at 365 days from Taking-Over — and surfaces them as active obligations and milestones.
requirements: Clause 4.2 Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over.
Clause 14.3 Retention released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.

capabilities.description: Answers every commercial question (claim value, retention, delay-damages exposure) only with a citation to document:harbourline_contract.pdf or document:harbourline_boq.xlsx, refusing to state a figure that no sourced line supports.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
